maddeler.e:
تتمالكي (form VI)
# تَتَمَالَكِي (tatamālakī) /ta.ta.maː.la.kiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
# تُتَمَالَكِي (tutamālakī) /tu.ta.maː.la.kiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
